name: Multiply
description: Multiplies two floating-point numbers. Like Add, the Blueprint Multiply node is variadic: additional input pins can be added to chain more multiplications. Returns the product of all connected inputs.

inputs.name: A
inputs.description: Multiplicand. Connect a float variable, a literal number, or the output of any node returning a float.

inputs.name: B
inputs.description: Multiplier. Connect a float variable, a literal number, or the output of any node returning a float.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: The product A * B (* any additional C, D, ... pins added by dragging the node).
